death.label: Forward fall - salvaged hold
death.sourceDescription: Lean, forward fall, ground contact, then hold the last intact frame before the scarf moves out of the source image. Entry: Ready. Exit: Intact prone hold. REVIEW: Source tail is cropped. Hold uses intact frame 218 at 9.083 seconds; subsequent settling is not reconstructed.

legacy-source-attack.label: Rightward lunging punch
legacy-source-attack.sourceDescription: Rightward weight transfer, extended punch, and recoil from the supplied combination. Entry: Opposite-strike transition. Exit: Guard.

walk.label: Move - brisk trot
walk.sourceDescription: Actual early locomotion is a brisk trot rather than a slow grounded walk. Source cadence preserved. Entry: Ready. Exit: Ready.

run.label: Run - broad stride
run.sourceDescription: A wider-stride running selection from the alternate take; no scale change applied. Entry: Ready. Exit: Ready.

jump.label: Rising-fist jump
jump.sourceDescription: Source preparation, rising-fist lift, tuck, descent, and crouched contact. Ends where the rebound starts. Entry: Moving stance. Exit: Rebound crouch.

rebound-jump.label: Rebound tuck jump
rebound-jump.sourceDescription: Second distinct jump from the same sequence; takeoff follows the first landing, then tucked flight and landing. Entry: Rebound crouch. Exit: Punch-ready stance.

attack.label: Cross - combo opener
attack.sourceDescription: Ready stance to cross extension; cut at the switch to the other arm. Entry: Ready. Exit: Lead-punch transition. REVIEW: Linked attack phase: no independent return to guard in this source interval.

lead-straight.label: Lead straight - combo middle
lead-straight.sourceDescription: Opposite arm extends as the opening cross retracts. The range begins at the arm-change boundary without adding a neutral reset. Entry: Opening-cross recoil. Exit: Finishing-cross chamber. REVIEW: Linked attack phase with no standalone neutral entry or exit.

cross-finisher.label: Cross - combo finisher
cross-finisher.sourceDescription: Third punch, forward extension, torso follow-through, and recovery to guard. One frame overlaps the middle phase. Entry: Lead-punch recoil. Exit: Ready.

finger-point.label: Point and streak
finger-point.sourceDescription: Step and finger-point gesture with original small moving streak. The entire existing streak stays in the wider canvas. Entry: Ready. Exit: Ready. REVIEW: Source effect is retained, not an approved new projectile ability. Keep this optional track under review.

death.label: Backward splat
death.sourceDescription: Brief preparation, backward fall, ground contact, and downed hold. Entry: Ready. Exit: Supine.

death-alt.label: Sit and roll back
death-alt.sourceDescription: Alternate seated collapse followed by a roll onto the back; complete source movement. Entry: Ready. Exit: Supine facing other side.

walk.label: Walk

run.label: Run
run.sourceDescription: One source running cycle with opposite arm and leg motion. Entry: Ready. Exit: Ready.

jump.label: Jump and landing
jump.sourceDescription: Compression, vertical jump, descent, ground contact, and recovery. The original white landing ring is retained. Entry: Running-to-crouch transition. Exit: Standing reset.

attack.label: Cross punch
attack.sourceDescription: Guard, cross extension toward screen-right, retraction, guard. Entry: Ready. Exit: Ready.

lead-jab.label: Lead jab - linked
lead-jab.sourceDescription: Guard rises, lead jab extends, then retracts into the next cross chamber. Isolated without inventing a neutral recovery. Entry: Raised guard. Exit: Cross chamber. REVIEW: Linked combo phase: the final chamber is not a stand-alone neutral reset.

hurt.label: Hit recoil
hurt.sourceDescription: Short source impact flash, wince, torso recoil, then standing recovery. Original white flash retained. Entry: Ready. Exit: Standing with tense mouth.

death.label: Kneeling side collapse
death.sourceDescription: Standing, knee buckle, kneel, side fall, intact grounded hold. Entry: Ready. Exit: Down on side.

death-alt.label: Backward fall
